detail.deactivateHint: Ho thibela ho thibela mosebelisi e mong le e mong oa sehahi sena hang-hang.

protection.placeholder: Matsatsi a ts'ireletso (ho se na letho = kamehla lefats'e)
protection.hint: Tšireletso e kopitsoang: matsatsi a 1-3650, kapa u tlohele letho ho sebelisa maemo a lefats'e a tsoang ho Litlhophiso. Phetoho e sebetsa feela ho ngoliso e ncha - tse seng li ntse li le teng li boloka nako ea tsona e felile.

matching.saved: Lipapiso tse tšoanang li ntlafalitsoe bakeng sa {{name}}
matching.hint: Ke lintlha life tse etsang hore ngoliso e 'meli e be moreki a le mong bakeng sa morero. Liphetoho li sebetsa ho licheke tse peli ho tloha joale ho ea pele; tshireletso e teng ha e amehe.
